name: Olive Folio
baseStyles: font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.75; color: #2f312b; background: #f3f0e6;

elementStyles.h1: font-size: 1.85em; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.5em 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #7b6a3f; padding-bottom: 0.3em;
elementStyles.h2: font-size: 1.3em; font-weight: 700; margin: 1.4em 0 0.4em 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d3c4; padding-bottom: 0.2em;
elementStyles.h3: font-size: 1.1em; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; margin: 1em 0 0.3em 0; color: #6f5c36;
elementStyles.h4: font-size: 1em; font-weight: 700; margin: 0.8em 0 0.3em 0; color: #6a6c60; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em;
elementStyles.blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #9b8b63; padding: 0.3em 0 0.3em 1.2em; margin: 1em 0; color: #65685b; font-style: italic; background: rgba(123,106,63,0.05); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
elementStyles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 1.2em 0; font-size: 0.94em; background: #fffef9; border: 1px solid #d9d3c4; border-radius: 6px;
elementStyles.th: font-weight: 700; text-align: left; padding: 0.55em 0.9em; font-size: 0.9em; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
elementStyles.codeInline: font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.88em; background: #ece8dc; color: #6f3b2c; padding: 0.15em 0.4em; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid #d9d3c4;
elementStyles.pre: background: #fffef9; border: 1px solid #b8b19f; border-radius: 6px; padding: 1em 1.2em; overflow-x: auto; margin: 1em 0;
elementStyles.codeBlock: font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.88em; color: #5e6057;

palette._provenance: primary/secondary/surface/border/text below are extracted verbatim from elementStyles above. error/warning/success/focusRing/hover shades are DERIVED — not in the original spec — to cover UI chrome the content theme didn't address. See design/README.md for the contrast verification behind each derived value.

componentStyles._provenance: DERIVED — not in the original spec. elementStyles above covers rendered content (headings, tables, code); Relay and Concord also need interactive chrome (buttons, inputs, focus states, status banners). These stay in the same hue family so nothing looks bolted on. The shell tokens (sidebar, navItem*, contextHeader, brand) were added for the multi-surface expansion: same palette, typography-led hierarchy, borders kept to single hairlines. terminalPanel is the one deliberately dark surface — ink derived by deepening textPrimary #2f312b, text from surfaceAlt #ece8dc, so the embedded terminal reads as part of Olive Folio rather than a foreign console.
componentStyles.buttonPrimary: background: #5e6538; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #5e6538; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1.1em; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.95em; cursor: pointer;
componentStyles.buttonSecondary: background: transparent; color: #2f312b; border: 1px solid #b8b19f; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 1.1em; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.95em; cursor: pointer;
componentStyles.buttonDisabled: background: #ece8dc; color: #b8b19f; border: 1px solid #d9d3c4; cursor: not-allowed;
componentStyles.input: background: #fffef9; color: #2f312b; border: 1px solid #d9d3c4; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 0.7em; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.95em;
componentStyles.statusError: color: #8a3626; background: rgba(138,54,38,0.08); border: 1px solid #8a3626; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;
componentStyles.statusWarning: color: #7a5420; background: rgba(122,84,32,0.08); border: 1px solid #7a5420; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;
componentStyles.statusSuccess: color: #3f6a3d; background: rgba(63,106,61,0.08); border: 1px solid #3f6a3d; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0.5em 0.8em;
componentStyles.emptyState: color: #65685b; font-style: italic; text-align: center; padding: 2em 1em;
componentStyles.brand: font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 1.15em; font-weight: 700; color: #2f312b; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.01em;
componentStyles.navItem: display: block; padding: 0.4em 0.8em; margin: 0.1em 0; color: #2f312b; text-decoration: none; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 0.97em; border-radius: 4px;
componentStyles.contextHeader: padding: 0.5em 0 0.6em; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9d3c4; color: #65685b; font-size: 0.92em; font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
componentStyles.terminalPanel: background: #22241e; color: #ece8dc; border: 1px solid #4a4f2c; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.6em;
